title: Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform)
text:
Demo Co. Spruce is a scale-up building fitness apps. We are looking for a mid-level Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform) to join our mobile team. Work is two office days a week in Brightwater Bay.

Our stack: kotlin. You will own the release process, ship features end to end and work closely with design and product.

A small, senior team.
